title: Board card writes never leave the main checkout dirty
notes: Retro 2026-11-26: in kamandsystem's main session, git pull failed 4 times with 'Your local changes to .dashboard/board/cards/*.json would be overwritten', and main sidestepped it with a throwaway worktree ('the board files the app keeps writing here'). The board command commits and pushes its own writes, so find which writer leaves uncommitted card files in the project checkout (the app's own UI writes, an offline fallback, a write raced against a pull, or a worktree board?) and make it commit them or never leave them there. Evidence: /tmp/retro2/00-ce-personal-kamandsystem.txt lines 498, 522, 547, 672, 697.

comments.body: Pull request #379 opened: Fast-forward the checkout past untracked files after a board sync https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/379

Review loop on #379: converged, ready to merge. 1 round, review found nothing, no fix commits, no conflict with main. CI passed on 0d4eac01. Scope matches the card: checkoutStep now ignores untracked files, so a checkout with an untracked .claude/ fast-forwards after a board write instead of keeping the card edit uncommitted. Still dirty by design: a checkout on another branch, one ahead of origin, or one with a tracked change outside .dashboard/.
